verdict.rationale: Milvus is documented as an open-source vector database. It can be self-hosted at three tiers: Milvus Lite as a local Python library, Standalone in Docker on a single machine, and Distributed on Kubernetes, all using the same client code. Community reports of running it on ARM hardware and implementing it directly corroborate real self-hosted use. Missing for 10: in-depth deployment and operations docs for Standalone/Distributed in the pack, and an explicitly named open-source license.
